stem:
Uma needs an ordered pair of numbers whose sum is 10 and whose difference (first minus second) is 4.

Which ordered pair is correct?

options.text: The second number 3 alone, without a first number.

teacher.key_rationale: 7 + 3 = 10 and 7 - 3 = 4, so (7, 3) fits both conditions. Swapping to (3, 7) flips the difference sign; (10, 4) only copies the given sum and difference.
